name: Lead a high-stakes deliberation
short_description: Lead a multi-session deliberation among opposing groups while preserving participation, evidence, and a traceable decision process.
self_assessment: I can lead three high-stakes deliberation sessions without help and produce a traceable final decision record.
description: Lead a multi-session deliberation among opposing groups while preserving participation, evidence, and a traceable decision process. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
